title: BIM semantic record contracts — review draft
description: Validates one table/row interchange envelope. JSON storage, object hydration, foreign keys and semantic truth are not implied.

Id.description: Opaque identity string, not a row offset. Stability across deliveries requires an explicit correspondence policy.

Decimal.description: Exact base-10 number serialized as a string. This does not prescribe database storage or arithmetic precision.

Evidence.description: Evidence and method are not proof of truth; referenced records must exist.

Unavailable.description: No value field is allowed. Not-exported needs supported exporter evidence; otherwise use not-observed. Conflict alternatives live in observation rows.

Pose.description: Coordinates are in the referenced frame. This is an anchor, not a complete geometric representation.

LocationValue.description: Place membership may overlap; absence of a pose does not imply origin coordinates. Labels are display context, not identity.

Snapshots.description: One published selection of source revisions and interpretation policies, not one building.

Objects.description: One provisionally or explicitly reconciled physical, spatial or logical identity across snapshots.

SourceRecords.description: One locator for an original record in an identified source revision; metadata records are not countable assets.

SourceLinks.description: One assertion linking a source record to an object; candidate links do not authorize merging or counting as equivalent.

ObjectStates.description: One description of an identified object in a snapshot; retirement and unobserved delivery status are distinct.

transformToParent.description: Row-major homogeneous matrix multiplying column vectors; null means no known transform. Schema does not establish orthogonality or invertibility.

CoordinateFrames.description: One declared coordinate frame in a snapshot; unaligned source frames remain unaligned.

resource.description: Opaque resource locator; not embedded mesh payload and not a storage format requirement.

Representations.description: One addressable representation of an object for a purpose; multiple representations do not create multiple physical objects.

Relationships.description: One directional relationship assertion; status and evidence distinguish accepted topology from candidates.

PropertyObservations.description: One observation of a semantic property concept on an object, preserving competing assertions as separate rows.

QuantityObservations.description: One quantity observation for an identified object measurement scope, kind and basis; competing measurements remain separate rows.

MaterialContributions.description: One material contribution to an object at a declared part/layer/scope; not an assembly total to add again to its constituents.

ReferenceSets.description: One identifiable edition of rates, environmental factors, rules or a vocabulary; authority is explicit.

WorkPackages.description: One named scope of work for a delivery, possibly spanning many objects; no independent point location is required.

Assessments.description: One requirement assessed against one subject in a specified scenario; unknown is not pass.

ComponentSchedule.description: One countable component occurrence in one snapshot, with readable context. Source metadata and definitions are excluded.

DoorSchedule.description: One door occurrence with selected specifications; clear opening width is not nominal leaf width.

RoofTakeoff.description: One roof occurrence under a selected measurement policy; surface and plan-projected area remain separate.

FinishSchedule.description: One identified finish surface/face of an object, with an available or unresolved space association. A shared wall can have independently measured finishes on opposite faces.

EstimateLines.description: One priced or explicitly unpriced quantity contribution within one package and rate scenario; alternative measurements do not create additive scope.

ImpactLines.description: One material contribution evaluated against one factor item, lifecycle module and scenario; alternative factor scenarios are not additive.

AssetRegister.description: One selected maintainable object, independent of the number of source descriptions or visual representations.

SpatialBounds.description: One axis-aligned envelope of one representation in a declared frame, in metres. Candidate filtering only; not an exact intersection, area or volume.

QuantityScopes.description: One identified measurement subject within an object: the whole occurrence, a material part, or a surface. Scope identity must survive quantity alternatives; it is not a quantity observation ID.
